sources.citation: Tedman et al., Efficient experimental characterization of the GPCRome via deep receptor scanning, Nat Commun 2026 (bioRxiv 2025.09.19.677468, PMC12458215)

sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Ca²⁺ response to surrogate agonist 8535n rescued (AUC 15.47 ± 1.47 vs. KO 3.54 ± 0.90; L4) and cAMP response to extracellular L-lactate rescued (AUC 18.08 ± 3.97 vs. KO 8.20 ± 1.04; L5) — function fully restored to wild-type levels.
sites.rationale: GPR27 has no signal peptide and its N-terminus (residues 1–22, EC1) is extracellular per the authoritative topology landmarks; TM1 begins at residue 23, placing the prepend site well (>3 residues) from any TM boundary. The ledger names no specific residue, but exactly one extracellular terminus exists, so the position is topology-derived as a prepend before M1 (insert_after_residue = 0). Functional rescue of both Ca²⁺ and cAMP signalling in GPR27-KO cells by pFLAG27 (L4, L5) confirms the FLAG-tagged receptor is correctly folded, trafficked to the surface, and fully functional. Full-length FLAG-tagged GPR27 (pFLAG27) was transiently re-expressed in CRISPR–Cas9 GPR27-knockout MEF cells. The ledger names no residue for the FLAG insertion. GPR27 is a GPCR with no signal peptide; its N-terminus (EC1, residues 1–22) is the sole extracellular terminus, making the N-terminal prepend the only topology-consistent placement.

sources.claim: We used single-cell Förster resonance energy transfer nanosensors to monitor cytosolic Ca  2+ and cAMP in wild-type 3T3 MEF cells, CRISPR–Cas9 GPR27-knockout cells (GPR27KO) and GPR27-knockout cells transiently re-expressing FLAG-tagged GPR27 (GPR27-rescued).

literature_notes: L1/L2 describe a GPR27–3×(GGGGS)–BioID2–HA C-terminal fusion confirmed by Western blot in HEK293 cells. The C-terminus of GPR27 falls in IC4 (residues 342–375, intracellular), so this tag is cytoplasmic and is recorded in other_positions rather than sites. L3/L4/L5 collectively ground the single surface site: L3 names the FLAG-tagged construct and the rescue experiment; L4 and L5 provide the quantitative functional readouts. No ledger line supports an internal extracellular-loop insertion for GPR27.

literature_other_positions.note: GPR27–BioID2–HA C-terminal fusion expressed in HEK293 cells; the C-terminus (residue 375, IC4 342–375) is intracellular, so this tag faces the cytoplasm and is not a surface-tag site.
